prose: you said you and builder can communicate. what i think we want is the ability for your shim to communicate with you via the same method. then your shim gets the alert and gets your attention. thoughts? ... well, i've seen you cut in on builder. and i agree it's a report. and given the things you've said, i think we only use it (if we can) to tell you that you've got mail. then you go read it and do whatever is the right thing
